name: km5fcb-hub-home
goal: Prove the signed-in Hub Home shows an actionable Mac publishing state and recovers from a failed shared-project read without leaving Projects in loading.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Production eb44e0d authenticates and grants owner, but /api/projects returns collaboration-disabled and /api/hub-home has no fresh snapshot. R2 holds a 33-project snapshot expired since 12:46:49 UTC. Spec covers recovery via a fresh owner snapshot and first-load failure.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: hub-home existing empty is a ready empty response and loading only resolves successfully. Register unavailable in the same UI scenario and drive the actual signed-in 503 plus granted null snapshot, retry and fresh Tracker recovery.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Isolated built app laptop dark regression on 22273708c7: actual heading Tracker is unavailable; expected Connect your Mac. Production-style owner null snapshot plus collaboration-disabled.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Scoped project failures end loading, fresh owner Tracker data fills the existing Projects card and dialog, and Home gives the owner a Mac sign-in step.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged built browser regression passed on fe1cdd30d2 and sealed the laptop capture. It verifies the Mac sign-in message, Projects recovery, authorized Tracker rows and the Project Overview link.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
